procurement.scope: Owner rejected approximately 825 USD fixture and deferred all lift work; current phase docs/GROUND_MODULE_DESIGN.md
procurement.basis: Selected purchased hardware; not yet installed or load-tested

confirmed.fan_ear_hole_center_spacing_basis: Owner's best estimate; not a machining tolerance
confirmed.fan_ear_dimension_basis: Owner confirms 4 mm holes, 3 mm screw-path thickness, 8 mm width and 20 mm height along the duct; holes centered in each ear. Ear's intake-side end is 39 mm from the motor-side duct end, excluding the motor.
confirmed.meter_rating_basis: Owner-supplied listing; not independently tested. Photo says 150A; listing says 0-200A.

center_ring.basis: Owner measures OD 75.5 mm, axial width 1.5 mm and center aligned with the ear-hole centers. Derived intake edge: 37 - 1.5/2 = 36.25 mm from intake face.

cable_exit.circumferential_location: Centered between the mounting ears, on one side of the housing
cable_exit.axial_location: On the motor side of the raised center ring
cable_exit.basis: Owner reports a 6 mm wide by 11 mm high cable-exit area and cable interference when that side is placed in the saddle. Exact dimension axes, protrusion and axial offset are not yet established.

housing_fit_gauge.observation: Ring gauge fits around the housing without force
housing_fit_gauge.scope: Local unpowered fit only; radial play, exact location, filament/profile and whole-cradle fit are not established

cradle_v1.observation: Cradle does not fit well because it does not account for the lip in the center of the body
cradle_v1.cause: Cradle and fan model omitted the raised circumferential ring; local gauge fit was insufficient to establish the full mounting profile
cradle_v1.next_action: Ring measured; check corrected v2 cradle on the actual fan before progressing to stand assembly

cradle_v2.observation: Owner reports the fan is mounted to the cradle with M3 nuts and bolts
cradle_v2.scope: Owner-reported installation; no proof-load, thermal, vibration or powered-stand validation
cradle_v2.cable_side_observation: Three cables emerge between the ears on the motor side of the ring; exit area reported as 6 mm wide by 11 mm high
cradle_v2.body_ring_fit_observation: Printed fine and fits perfectly, including the center ring, on the side without the three cables; does not fit over the cable-exit side

mounting_board.next_action: Deferred with all lift work; retain board proposal for later review

orientation.basis: Use the owner-confirmed fitting side as the underside: cradle below fan, cable exit above it, ears on the two shelves. Cable-down fit is not supported by v2.

center_ring_relief.basis: Trial groove OD 76.1 mm and width 2.5 mm around the measured 75.5 x 1.5 mm ring; verify on the printed part

retaining_mount.fan_washer_basis: M3 DIN 433 small-series metal washer, 3.2 mm ID x 6 mm OD x 0.5 mm. Prior 7 mm OD collides with the measured ring at inward screw positions. Center screws and washers in the ear holes and verify a visible gap to the ring.

layout.scale_body_envelope_basis: Packaging allowance; owner platform measurement governs. Verify case/display clearance.
layout.fan_package_allowance_basis: Full-package allowance only; measured duct is 66 mm long, lip OD 75.5 mm, ear span 91 mm. Motor protrusion remains unmeasured.
layout.fan_axial_mount_position: Hole and ring planes are 37 mm from inlet; groove spans 35.75-38.25 mm. Owner confirms body/ring fit opposite the cable exit and installation with M3 nuts and bolts. Next: attach cradle to moving mounting board.

screening.limits_basis: Proposed experiment limits, not automatic protection or hardware validation. Final run duration, thermal and cell-voltage limits remain to set.
